parsed.name: Keithley 2400/2182 I-V测量系统
parsed.description: 由Keithley 2400源表与2182纳伏表组成的精密电学测量系统，用于向样品施加电流并测量微弱电压信号，常用于I-V扫描、电阻表征和低噪声电输运实验。
parsed.description_en: A precision electrical measurement system combining a Keithley 2400 SourceMeter and a 2182 nanovoltmeter. It is used to source current into a sample and measure very small voltage signals for I-V sweeps, resistance characterization, and low-noise transport experiments.

actions.description: 配置2400源表的电流输出量程和电压保护限值。
actions.description_en: Configure the 2400 SourceMeter current output range and voltage compliance limit.
Connect to the Keithley 2400 SourceMeter and 2182 nanovoltmeter.

actions.description: 在指定电流下进行单点测量，并对电压读数取平均。
actions.description_en: Perform a single measurement point at the specified current and average the voltage readings.

actions.description: 执行电流扫描并记录I-V测量数据。
actions.description_en: Run a current sweep and record the I-V measurement data.

actions.description: 安全关闭源输出并停止测量仪器。
actions.description_en: Safely turn off the source output and stop the measurement instruments.
